seoTitle: Granja Maripepa | HORECA distribution in Murcia
seoDescription: Food distribution for hospitality from Lorca. Frozen, chilled and ambient products for restaurants, catering and collectives in Murcia and Almería.
illustration: Illustrative photograph. Ask about available formats.
brandsIntro: Grupo Topgel, Nestlé and Panamar appear in our published offer. Their websites provide additional brand information; ask our team about the supply conditions for your establishment.
catalogueNotice: The public catalogue is being prepared. This journey introduces product families, not stock or prices.

chapters.label: 01 · Threshold
chapters.title: The kitchen begins before the flame.
chapters.lead: Before a dish reaches the table, someone chooses the ingredients. Granja Maripepa was founded in Lorca in 1966 and distributes food for hospitality, restaurants and catering.

supports.title: From Lorca
supports.text: Saprelorca is our starting point. Talk to the team, describe your establishment and direct your enquiry towards the families you need. A specific conversation gives a product list its context.

supports.title: For your service
supports.text: A restaurant and a catering service may have different questions. Tell us what you are looking for and use this visit to explore the published range before confirming individual items and conditions.

chapters.label: 02 · Cold
chapters.title: Every food has its own place.
chapters.lead: Frozen, chilled and ambient products form part of our published activity. They are different ways to organise a supply enquiry. Explain the kind of product your kitchen needs from the outset.

supports.title: Frozen
supports.text: Grupo Topgel's range includes frozen seafood, meat, prepared foods and pastry. Start with a family, then ask about the item, presentation and information you need to consider it for your menu.

supports.title: Chilled and ambient
supports.text: Granja Maripepa also publishes activity in these temperatures. Their presence here does not mean that every item is available. Confirm the particular product and its conditions with the team.

supports.title: Information before choosing
supports.text: The photographs introduce each family. Request the specific product documentation for ingredients, allergens, formats and storage. An illustrative image cannot replace a product specification.

chapters.label: 03 · Range
chapters.title: A path through what your kitchen needs.
chapters.lead: The published range is organised into seven families. This page presents four: seafood, meat, prepared foods and pastry. You do not need an item code to begin. Start with the preparation you have in mind and bring that need to the conversation.

supports.title: Families, not a stock display
supports.text: Each link leads to a description of a family. The public catalogue is still being prepared. Sample items, quantities and prices are not presented as verified availability.

supports.title: Brands with their own names
supports.text: Grupo Topgel, Nestlé and Panamar have a place in the published offer. Their official websites provide context, without replacing the particular terms agreed for your establishment.

chapters.label: 04 · Route
chapters.title: The next stop is a conversation.
chapters.lead: Your establishment's location and requirements are the start of a delivery enquiry. Speak to us to confirm coverage, conditions and supply arrangements. This page does not replace that confirmation with a general delivery promise.

supports.title: Call
supports.text: Lorca's published telephone is 968 46 75 14. The mobile number 639 77 86 55 is also available as a contact channel. Choose the option that suits your enquiry.

supports.title: Write
supports.text: The Contact page publishes pedidos@granjamaripepa.com for enquiries and orders. Include your establishment's name, location and the families you are interested in. Do not include account passwords.

supports.title: Time to talk
supports.text: Published contact hours are Monday to Friday, 08:00–13:00 and 16:00–19:00. Keep the item reference or document to hand when asking about a particular product or service detail.

chapters.label: 05 · Table
chapters.title: Your kitchen.
chapters.lead: This journey leads to the professional's work. Hospitality, restaurants and catering are the sectors Granja Maripepa addresses. A range makes sense when it responds to your establishment's needs.

supports.title: From an idea to an enquiry
supports.text: Ask about a family, find additional brand information or request product documentation. A focused enquiry helps identify what still needs to be confirmed before a decision.

supports.title: Your commercial relationship
supports.text: Existing customers retain their own customer-area access. For an initial conversation or a range enquiry, use the published contact channels. You do not need to start a purchase to ask for information.

chapters.label: Manifesto
chapters.title: Alongside those who feed others.
chapters.lead: From Lorca, since 1966. Our published purpose is to support restaurant professionals through food distribution and help with the work of the kitchen. This journey is an introduction; product and service details are confirmed with you.

supports.title: A range to discuss
supports.text: Families, brands and dated documents help prepare the conversation.

supports.title: A team to call
supports.text: Published contact channels provide a clear next step.
